flows.userFlow: Create a named CSS Grid area and place its child in that area.

steps.description: Confirm the child is placed in the declared named grid area.

assertions.assertion: The displayed placement identifies the named grid area and the grid has connected cells.

flows.userFlow: Reject a disconnected CSS Grid named area.

steps.description: Inspect the validation result for the disconnected named area.

assertions.assertion: The disconnected area is rejected and no valid placement is claimed.

flows.userFlow: Place an item against inherited subgrid tracks.

steps.description: Inspect the child placement relative to inherited tracks.

assertions.assertion: The child placement uses the parent track geometry when the engine supports subgrid.

steps.description: Resize the viewport to the narrow layout.
Inspect the resulting wrapped item positions.

assertions.assertion: Items wrap at the narrow viewport without overlapping or disappearing.

flows.userFlow: Verify a transformed element transitions to its final state.

steps.description: Open the transform and transition fixture.
Wait for the final transform state.

assertions.assertion: The element reaches the expected final transform and reports the configured transition.
The dark color-scheme uses the declared dark custom-property values.

steps.description: Inspect the documented matching and non-matching elements.

assertions.assertion: The fixture reports the expected matching elements and excludes the documented non-matches.
